claims.statement: The kit ships content (markdown layout and conventions) not a runtime service: package.json name agent-knowledge-starter v2.0.0 has empty dependencies, devDependencies are skills/remark/markdown-link-check, and scripts are format/check with test intentionally erroring.

Peer dependencies are Node >=22 plus global openspec (@fission-ai/openspec) and openwiki with openwiki --init; no script ever installs them and missing tools fail fast printing exact npm i -g commands and exiting 2.

check_peer_tools.mjs exports INSTALL_COMMANDS, onPath, missing, requireBinaries; standalone and importable; unknown tool names exit 2 naming the unknown tool, missing tools print one error per tool plus install commands and exit 2, PATH-only check.

Distribution is via Skills CLI: npx skills add Hypercubed/Agent-Knowledge-Starter-Kit installs .agents/skills/* and skips metadata.internal:true folders; each skill's bootstrap/ must be preserved because initialization copies from it and idempotent re-runs depend on the original name; --all flag sprays into every known agent directory.

Skill-first install flow requires running each installed SKILL.md Skill initialization once (copy-missing-only), suggested order task-closeout for closeout-only else learning-distill first, then attaching AKSK routing note via attach_section.mjs and registering SKILL.md paths; definitions may live globally but outputs belong under target repo .agents/.

Single .agents tree is the source of truth for durable repo knowledge; root AGENTS.md is the checkout entrypoint that routes into .agents/AGENTS.md, durable guidance is never duplicated into tool-native config, and tool switching does not invalidate knowledge because on-disk layout is stable.

example/.agents is a disposable generated illustration not a second source of truth; it must be regenerated when portable kit content or bootstrap behavior changes and never populated by copying the dogfood curated wiki.

generate-example/run.sh rebuilds example/ by rm -rf and recreate, writing README stub, running npx skills add repo-root --copy --agent cursor, simulating learning-distill init by copying bootstrap templates for playbooks/README, sessions/README and AGENTS.md when missing, and writing .agents/.gitignore with sessions/* and !sessions/README.md; internal skill is excluded because Skills CLI skips metadata.internal:true.

attach_section.mjs is the single append-only idempotent mechanism for N marker-delimited root sections; markers are read from the template (routing-note-template.md AKSK:ROUTING, lifecycle-template.md AKSK:LIFECYCLE), content outside markers is never replaced, re-runs are no-op when current or refresh in place when template changed, missing target file is created, unknown template exits 2.

attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends the curation section from wiki-contract-template.md between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers to an existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, never creates the file or removes OpenWiki-owned content, is idempotent/self-updating, and fail-fasts with exit 2 and openwiki --init when missing; stub-aware reporting for default stub.

sync_wiki_indexes.mjs refreshes all OpenWiki directory indexes deterministically with no LLM and no CLI run by locating global openwiki via npm root -g, importing agent/docs-only-backend.js and okf/index-sync.js, constructing OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly and virtualMode, and calling synchronizeWikiIndexes; exits 2 when openwiki missing or package not installed globally.

Core wiring pattern: tool-native files (bootstrap files, project rules, command wrappers, local config) are wiring; .agents/ files are durable repo knowledge; never copy long-lived policy into tool-native config, point the tool at .agents/AGENTS.md, openwiki/index.md, .agents/playbooks/, and .agents/skills/.

Four pattern groups are documented: root AGENTS.md native (Codex/OpenCode/Kilo/Warp/OpenClaw via AKSK:ROUTING), tool-specific bootstrap file (Claude Code CLAUDE.md, Gemini GEMINI.md), rules-based IDE wiring (Cursor .cursor/rules/, Copilot .github/copilot-instructions.md), persistent memory & runtime boundary (Hermes/Antigravity/OpenClaw/Agentic Sandbox) with session export to .agents/sessions/.

Session export rule and gitignore contract: native memory stays local, closeout bundles (.agents/sessions/<folder>/ with summary.json canonical task_id) are the shared task boundary for any later tool to distill; only sessions/README.md is tracked (sessions/* plus !sessions/README.md) enforced via git ls-files and git status --ignored.

check-agents-structure.sh validates any .agents tree for required files (AGENTS.md, .gitignore, playbooks/README, sessions/README, four SKILL.md and task-closeout bundle files), session tracking, SKILL.md frontmatter, and JSON via jq; check-publish.sh composes it plus remark formatting, markdown-link-check excluding example/, rg leakage and doubled .agents/.agents hygiene; both degrade gracefully when optional tools absent.

Integration guides live under docs/integrations/ not .agents/, currently 14 product guides plus patterns and README; each is a quick reference with filenames/snippets/caveats while shared concepts live once in patterns.md; planned VS Code extensions only after verification.
